_README: Leg-state OVERLAY for the OPG formalization manifest. The manifest (opg_corpus_manifest.json) is REGENERATED by build_opg_manifest.py, so per-milestone leg progress lives here instead and is MERGED (not overwritten) at build time; the builder VALIDATES this overlay (slugs exist; states allowed; non-todo states carry commit+package provenance). Keyed by manifest slug. Update via the workflow's legs_update + a human acceptance check (meta/check_milestone.py).

seymours_self_minor_conjecture.note: D4inf2: every infinite_graph G is a proper minor of itself via minor_model (branch sets, reachP-connected) + proper_witness (3-way: vertex-del/contraction/edge-del). Audited done: identity model provably fails proper_witness (grounding identity_not_proper), infinite_graph guard load-bearing (finite G refutable), iRay is a concrete proper self-minor; axiom-free.

unfriendly_partitions.note: D4inf1: 2-partition p; unfriendly p = forall x, card_le (own_nbr)(cross_nbr) (choice-free cardinal <=); guarded countable_graph. Audited done: constant/parity p trivialization fails (grounding: Komega const not unfriendly), single-edge/K3/star/Komega all admit unfriendly partitions (no refutation), axiom-free.

strong_matchings_and_covers.note: D4inf4: iHypergraph carrier; edges<=k => exists strongly_maximal_matching /\ strongly_minimal_cover, |.\.| compared via choice-free card_le on symmetric-difference sets. universal_highly_arc_transitive_digraphs.note: D4inf4: iDigraph carrier; exists locally-finite HAT universal digraph. highly_arc_transitive = UNFOLDED automorphism action (adjacency-preserving bijection on directed paths, no group object); universal via alt_walk_from/walk_uses (polarity-flipping alternating walk).
